'''Graith starport''' was a military-grade [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the plateau above the [[O'beki]] of [[Graith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Surrounded by high [[blast wall]]s, it was connected to [[Graith]] by a roadway referred to as the "[[Grand Avenue (Graith)|Grand Avenue]]."

The starport was divided into two sections. The larger part of the facility was given over to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military facility. Two full [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were stationed at the base, along with several [[Tribune-class shuttle|''Tribune''-class shuttles]].

A smaller area was given over to commercial traffic. Security was provided by a dozen [[K7 "Black Dagger" Security Droid]]s and customs officials.
